Materials and Methods

During optimization, mobile phase A containing 0.05% trifluoroacetic acid was tested.

The selected method used a YMC-Pack ODS-AQ (150 x 4.6 mm, 3 um) column.

Eluent A: water. Eluent B: acetonitrile.

Eluent A contained 0.1% formic acid and was adjusted to pH 3.2.

The flow rate was 1.0 mL/min and the column temperature was 30 C.

A trial run time of 20 min was evaluated during optimization.

The selected method run time was 12 min.

The selected gradient was 10 to 90% B over 10 min, return to initial over 2 min.

Results

During optimization, compound 4a had a retention time of 3.2 min.

Under the selected method, intermediate 2 had a retention time of 7.4 min.
